format.decision: Clear decision statement (APPROVED, REJECTED, DEFERRED, etc.)

example.question: Should we approve the use of Aura Teal 100 for dark mode text to address contrast issues?
evidence: WCAG AA contrast ratio test results (1.8:1 for base Aura Teal on Obsidian)
Brand identity requirement for Aura Teal as accent color
Visual design mockups showing Aura Teal 100 usability
example.rationale: Base Aura Teal fails WCAG AA on dark backgrounds but brand identity requires Aura Teal as accent. Aura Teal 100 provides sufficient contrast (4.5:1) while maintaining brand expression.
consequences: Improved accessibility compliance for AURA in dark mode
Need to update documentation to specify Aura Teal 100 for dark mode text
No impact on light mode usage
Developer education required on proper usage
